topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I just got the most unexpected suggestion from my neighbor, Mike. He came over this afternoon, looking a bit more hesitant than usual, and asked if he could use a corner of my yard for a garden. Apparently, he's been looking for a spot to grow some veggies and herbs, and the sunny patch by my fence caught his eye. I hadn’t thought anyone would be interested in that space. I told him I’d need to think about it, but I’m really intrigued by the idea. It could be interesting to see what he can do with that area.
